# commander_epm_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing **EPM (Endpoint Policy Management) policy** by its Keeper-assigned **policy ID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "commander_epm_policy" "example" {
  policy = "your-epm-policy-id"

  # Optional, MSP only
  # managed_company = "Acme Corp"
}

output "epm_policy_name" {
  value = data.commander_epm_policy.example.policy_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `policy` (String) EPM policy ID to look up (same value as the commander_epm_policy resource id).

### Optional

- `managed_company` (String) Only applies to **MSP accounts**. **Name** or **ID** of the managed company to scope this data source to. Omit to use the logged-in account context.

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Set of String) Application collection IDs or `"*"` for all applications.
- `control` (Set of String) Control actions.
- `date_filter` (Set of String) Date filter ranges in ISO format `YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `day_filter` (Set of String) Day filter.
- `id` (String) EPM policy ID (same as policy).
- `machine_collections` (Set of String) Machine collection IDs or `"*"` for all machines.
- `policy_name` (String) Display name of the EPM policy.
- `policy_type` (String) Policy type.
- `status` (String) Policy status.
- `time_filter` (Set of String) Time filter ranges in 24h format.
- `user_groups` (Set of String) User collection IDs or `"*"` for all users.
